question: Does AXIS recover a reproducible type-I-interferon blood signature in human systemic lupus erythematosus while keeping incompatible biological contexts separate?
population: human systemic lupus erythematosus cases and non-autoimmune controls
primary_stratum: peripheral whole blood, case-control, untreated contrast where identifiable
eligibility_guardrails: participant-level case and control assignment recoverable
no repeated participant counted as independent
disease, tissue, platform, treatment and age reviewed before role assignment
no pooling across whole blood, PBMC or purified-cell strata
candidate accessions require manual eligibility approval
failure_policy: Report not_passed without changing criteria or substituting cohorts after seeing the ranked genes.
claim_boundary: A pass supports recovery of known SLE interferon biology only; it is not a new biomarker claim or proof of general superiority.
